body:
Hey @mthuret !

Are you suggesting to use `connectInfiniteHits` in just the `ShowMoreResults` component instead of `createConnector`? I thought about seeing if I could use the `connectInfiniteHits` connector but I wasn't completely sure as to how to actually implement it. Not sure if you had an example for this but that would be helpful. Would I would wrap the `ShowMoreResults` component in `connectInfiniteHits` when I mount it in `SiteSearch`?

Yeah when I left the `ShowMoreResults` component mounted and tried to maintain the same behavior, clicking "show more" would initially show the correct results, but if I clicked "back to results" and then "show more" in a different category, it wouldn't update the results, so it would display the previous category results in the "show more" view. Not until I went back and clicked "show more" would it update so it seemed as if there was a lag maybe.
